verdict_reason: Coverage-gap FRESH review: @AfterEach ProxySelector restore is a no-op (Minor).

todos.issue: @AfterEach cleanup calls ProxySelector.setDefault(ProxySelector.getDefault()), which is a no-op and leaves the selector installed by configureProxy_validUrl / proxySelector_bypassesLocalhost in place for later tests in the JVM.
todos.fix: Capture ProxySelector.getDefault() in a field before configureProxy mutates it, and restore that saved selector in @AfterEach.
